questions.question: When the psalm writer Asaph was in a day of deep trouble, how did his soul respond to comfort?
After asking hard questions about God in the night, what did the psalm writer Asaph decide to remember?
The psalm writer Asaph said God saved His people with power. Which people did he name?

answers.text: The sons of Jacob and Joseph
The sons of Moab and Ammon
The sons of Esau and Ishmael

questions.question: In Asaph's psalm about God's wonders, how did God lead His people?

answers.text: Like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron
Like an army by the hand of Joshua and Caleb
Like a nation by the hand of David and Solomon
